network_enforcement: The checker invokes check_proof.sh inside Bubblewrap with the host mounted read-only, a disposable /tmp, and --unshare-net. It uses only the existing pinned local Lean closure and cannot fetch or mutate it. This is still warm nonrelease evidence, not an empty-cache cold build.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release reconciliation summary

coverage_semantics: covered_obligation_ids receive only provisional warm kernel-observation coverage. reconciled_inventory_ids are inspected to derive a fail-closed terminal decision and receive no accepted closure credit.
scope_boundary: Fail-closed current-snapshot reconciliation of provisional proof and validation evidence. The checker verifies hashes, receipt fields, graph state, and re-elaborates the exact root. It cannot master-accept dependencies, establish H0/R0 or AUDIT-Z, accept foundation/provenance/TCB closure, provide a clean cold offline build or independent verification, or assemble a deterministic release bundle.
